rtoBook.label: RTO cost book on Reports
rtoBook.help: Shows what each returned parcel really cost (both courier legs, packaging, handling, ad share) on Reports › Delivery & RTO, by district, campaign, product, courier and reason. Off until switched on. The figures come from Money › Costs & fees; a part not entered is named, never counted as zero.

claims.label: Courier claims for lost or damaged parcels
claims.help: Lets staff raise a claim with the courier for a lost or damaged parcel (its declared value) and follow it until the courier settles or rejects it. Off until switched on. A claim is a record only; nothing is paid from here.

riderIssues.label: Rider issues (overcharge complaints)
riderIssues.help: Support › Rider issues: a customer says the rider took more than the parcel asked. Staff log it with photo proof; a person approves or rejects it, and approval opens a courier claim for the exact extra. 'Ask a refund' only creates a refund request that still needs the owner's approval on the refunds list. Off until switched on.
